label_definition: These source-backed records identify aircraft involved in accidents or documented in-flight emergencies. They are outcome labels, not ADS-B declaration labels. The event aircraft must not be marked positive at every timestamp; forecasting labels are generated from event time, uncertainty, and a stated prediction horizon.

events.event_time_source: NTSB Reports lists the event at 13:53 EDT; converted to 17:53 UTC. Treat as minute-level timing, not a recorder-synchronized timestamp.
events.collection_notes: NTSB confirms the event, date, flight number, and runway overrun. The fetched trace identifies registration N1997A, matching the event record; the event time is only minute-level.

The AAIB preliminary report identifies VT-ANB and says the crash occurred shortly after takeoff. The short pre-event duration may limit forecasting value; retain as an outcome case, not automatically as a declaration case.

aircraft.collection_notes: Government hearing material says PAT25 was not required to broadcast ADS-B Out on this mission. Do not treat a missing ADSB.lol trace as a failed download or as evidence the helicopter was absent.

events.collection_notes: NTSB confirms the airliner identity and event time. The helicopter's accident path was reconstructed from non-ADSB sources, so this aircraft-only fetch cannot reproduce the full collision geometry.

The NTSB preliminary report says FAA ADS-B track data covered approximately one minute and that no distress call was received. This is an accident-outcome case with very limited lead-time telemetry, not a known emergency declaration.

events.event_time_source: NTSB states about 5:13 p.m. Pacific standard time on January 5; converted to 01:13 UTC on January 6.
events.collection_notes: Official NTSB sources document the door-plug separation and rapid depressurization. The aircraft trace has not been fetched; no training windows are assigned from this case yet.
